call_points.text: Management says margins will stay under pressure for at least 1–2 months until the West Asia crisis resolves.
Management calls the higher capex a prepayment of spend, not an increase in the total needed to tap the geography.
Company is zero-debt and prepared to raise debt for capex and CBG plants; dividend of ~₹30 per share to be maintained.
Management declined to give a Q2 APM/NWG/pooled allocation figure, saying it does not make sense to share it.
CBG plant of ~350 tonnes municipal solid waste (first phase) to be set up on MCGM land after agreement and land allocation.
Open to acquisitions as APM allocation falls and new non-gas operators enter; most geographies already bid out by PNGRB.
Domestic PNG and CNG are fully supplied from domestic gas; CNG volume rose 7.12% YoY in Q4.
A ₹1 CNG price hike was taken on 22 April 2026; the full gas cost increase has not been passed through.
Pooled gas pricing is set by GAIL and not visible to MGL; Henry Hub supply was cut to about 50% of the 1.5 contracted quantity in March.
Monsoon from June-July will slow pipeline laying on public roads, limiting the pace of new connections.

operating_notes.text: Q4 FY26 average sales volume was 4.672 mmscmd (CNG 3.349, domestic PNG 0.605, I&C 0.719 mmscmd); FY26 average was 4.585 mmscmd.
MGL had 518 CNG stations, 5,924 industrial and commercial customers and over 3.21 million domestic households connected as on 31 March 2026.
Henry Hub supply was curtailed to about 50% of the 1.5 contracted quantity in March; spot LNG was sourced at $11.5-13 per unit.
Gas sourcing mix: ~30% APM, ~21-22% NWG and pooled combined, ~14-15% HPHT, ~21-22% received through Henry Hub contracts, rest Brent-linked and spot.
I&C realisations rose ₹27-32 per SCM over the previous quarter, 70-80% higher year on year, as pricing is linked to alternate fuels (bulk LPG for commercial, FO/LDO for industrial).
Unison Enviro SBUs contributed ~0.322 mmscmd in Q1FY27 versus ~0.224 mmscmd a year ago, against a stated potential of ~1.2 mmscmd.

timeline.summary: On its 8 May 2026 Q4 FY26 call, MGL reported FY26 PAT of ₹847 Cr (FY25: ₹1,041 Cr) and guided FY27 volume growth above FY26's 8.25%, with capex at the ₹1,200 Cr range.
On 31 July 2026 MGL's Q1FY27 call reported PAT of ₹194 Cr (up 46.8% QoQ) on 4.766 mmscmd volumes, guided FY27 capex at ₹1,500–1,800 Cr and flagged margin pressure from the West Asia gas disruption.
